[![Discord 鏈接到「LopyMine 的項目」Discord 服務器](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21f178aff2b64844fefeaf94a3a3a418440fd43f.png)](https://discord.gg/NZzxdkrV4s) [![Github 鏈接-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d87060a9e4522786e45b4b54d10853a1b4a91b10.png)](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles) [![支持鏈接-Banner [Boosty]](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce91fef079649dee277c52a998fc068e745e99e.png)](https://boosty.to/lopymine/donate) [![CurseForge 鏈接-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c39affcb732c8b1a4fe189e79898c686da3d63e2.png)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/inventory-particles) [![Modrinth 鏈接-Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9991553f6a20e5105b9b153b8d817bc3630c18a8.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/inventory-particles) !["描述" 標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image2.webp?raw=true) **Inventory Particles（背包粒子）** — 一款視覺效果模組，為你的物品欄物品添加了大量新粒子！使用它，你可以讓你的物品欄更加生動和動態！當然，這完全是客戶端的功能。 ![遊戲內展示](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/ima222ge.webp?raw=true) ![標籤「1300+ 紋理，800+ 區域，400+ 配置」](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b31510bc5bff1c5c150a1aadb6a317e220882f6c.png) ![這裡只是裝飾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) !["可配置" 標題](https://github.com/LopyMine/Profile/blob/main/files/Template%20Resource%20Pack/image.webp?raw=true) Inventory Particles 中的所有粒子都是**數據驅動**的！這意味著你只需使用資源包和一些基本配置即可添加更多粒子！ **你可以自定義：** 1) 物理效果（加速度、減速、衝量等） 2) 旋轉（實際旋轉和視覺旋轉） 3) 大小（+ 動畫） 4) 顏色（+ 動畫） 5) 紋理（+ 動畫） 6) 持有者（生成粒子的物品） 7) 生成區域（僅帶有附加紋理） 8) 生命週期（刻） 9) 以及其他小細節 ^^ > 不幸的是，我們還沒有時間製作維基，所以目前你可以嘗試自己摸索 😅
配置示例 ```json { "life_time": 100, "animation_type": "stretch", "animation_speed": 1.0, "size": { "width": 8.0, "height": 8.0 }, // 或者 "size": { // https://nicmulvaney.com/easing "interpolation": "ease_in_quint", "sizes": { "0": { "width": 16.0, "height": 16.0, // 覆蓋 "ease_in_quint" "interpolation": "linear" }, "50": { "width": 32.0, "height": 32.0 }, "100": { "width": 64.0, "height": 64.0 } } }, "textures": [ "inventory-particles:example/texture_0.png", "inventory-particles:example/texture_1.png" ], "holders": [ { "item": "minecraft:potion", "spawn_area": "example_spawn_area.png", "spawn_count": [0, 1], "spawn_frequency": [5, 20], "speed_coefficient": 0.3, "color": "#AARRGGBB", // 或者 "color": { // 混合、隨機、靜態隨機、漸變、漸變隨機靜態、漸變循環、漸變反彈 "mode": "gradient", "values": ["#FF8CC091", "#003700", "nbt", "nbt_list"], "speed": 5.0 }, "nbt_conditions_match": "none", "nbt_conditions": [ { "this_name": "components", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": { "this_name": "minecraft:potion_contents", "this_type": "object", "next_match": "any", "next": [ { "this_name": "potion", "this_type": "string", "check_value": "minecraft:water" } ] } } ] } ], "physics": { "base": { "x_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "y_speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0], "cursor_impulse_inherit_coefficient": 1.0 }, "angle_speed": { "impulse": [1.0, 1.5], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": [-100.0, 100.0], "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "rotation": { "particle": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 360.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": false, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } }, "texture": { "spawn_angle": [0.0, 0.0], "rotate_in_movement_direction": false, "speed": { "impulse": [0.0, 0.0], "impulse_bidirectional": true, "acceleration": 0.0, "acceleration_bidirectional": false, "max_acceleration": 0.0, "braking": 0.0, "turbulence": [0.0, 0.0] } } } } } ```
![這裡只是裝飾](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e66456118e8d1bd51d25bd166f33d70e008a0fe6_0.webp) ![展示](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c681a00eaa95d93c03b28566a266f2aad3707e5f.png) ### ![圖標](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9111988448f778aaff9ac4477e463343fe4dc7e4.png) 想要支持模組和作者嗎？告訴大家這個模組吧！ 沒錯，你說得對。僅僅通過宣傳，你就能很好地支持這個模組及其創作者。知道這個模組的人越多，下載量就會越高，更多的下載量會給作者帶來良好的動力，並增加來自網站的收入（實質上是免費捐贈）。**請記住，宣傳必須不能具有侵入性和煩人！** ### 你可以做什麼？ - 製作視頻評論/廣告 - 告訴你的朋友這個模組 - 只是下載這個模組（如果你想玩的話 :D） # 📑 許可證 [**查看原始模組存儲庫。**](https://github.com/LopyMine/Inventory-Particles)
